summary: The customer called to complain about an unexpected thirty dinar extra charge on their bill for a third-party gaming service. The agent investigated, explained how the subscription might have occurred, and offered a one-time courtesy waiver, which the customer rejected because they wanted it treated as a company error rather than a favor. The agent then agreed to block all premium content services and submitted a refund request for the thirty dinars, resolving the customer's issue.
